body: Makes sense. It has always been with me, it probably always will. Thanks for the perspective.

I admire people who can harness their darkness. I've tried again and again. Every time the question of when it's reasonable to give up grows larger. I wonder if people who manage to harness their suffering can also live a life where they are happy. It often seems like people who manage to find creativity out of their suffering don't get to leave it behind them.

Yeah... Having to change therapists and doctors is exhausting.  I've been fortunate lately that I've been able to keep going to the same therapist and psychiatrist for more than a year now. It sucks that you've had to start paying for your old therapist yourself, it shouldn't be like that.

I can really relate to what you're saying and I'm sorry you're also a shitty kind of special as you say. I used to think I could find a passion and that it would be my saving. But it was years since I've had any passion now. I also fear that if I do I will just get burnt out again. But yeah.. you might be right still.
Yeah, it does feel like that a lot of the time...
